fidelity: F2a — Stefan-problem lumped enthalpy method with moving freeze/melt front
source: ASHRAE (2020) Handbook — HVAC Systems and Equipment, ch.51 'Thermal Storage'; Dincer & Rosen (2021) Thermal Energy Storage 3rd ed., Wiley; Voller & Cross (1981) Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 24(3) 545-556 (enthalpy method); Alexiades & Solomon (1993) Mathematical Modeling of Melting and Freezing Processes, Hemisphere.

unit.name: Generic 500 kWh_th ice-on-coil thermal storage (cylindrical coil bank in water tank)

capacity_kwh.note: Latent capacity at full ice fraction = m_water*h_fusion

h_fusion.note: Latent heat of fusion of water (333.55 kJ/kg, rounded)

cp_water.note: Specific heat of liquid water (0-20 C)

cp_ice.note: Specific heat of ice near 0 C

k_ice.note: Thermal conductivity of ice at 0 C

coil_area_m2.note: Total heat-transfer surface area of the coil bank

coil_radius_m.note: Outer radius of coil tube (1 inch OD nominal)

h_coil_water.note: Film coefficient coil-wall to bulk water (natural/forced convection)

UA_ambient.note: Tank shell heat-loss coefficient to surroundings

T_brine_charge.note: Chiller brine supply temperature during ice build

T_brine_discharge.note: Warm return fluid during cooling discharge
